components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/screens/terminal-simulator?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

components.name: screen-recording
components.title: Screen Recording
components.description: The treatment that turns a raw screen capture into a shot: crop the browser and OS chrome off each edge as a fraction, fit what is left to the frame, and run a keyframed camera that pushes in on whatever matters at a given frame and holds until the next move. Takes a video or a still through the same track.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/screens/screen-recording?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

components.name: count-grid
components.title: Count Grid
components.description: A grid of cards rushes in under a horizontal smear, settles on five and a label, then the camera pulls back a fraction while every empty cell around them fills in from the middle out and the number jumps. The "and it scales" shot, without a cut — one card is deliberately late to land, which is what makes the entry read as five separate things arriving rather than one picture being pushed in.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/count-grid?ref=cli — pass cards an array of image URLs and from/to/noun for the label.

components.name: roster-grant
components.title: Roster Grant
components.description: Three rows of roster cards stream past a call to action, a pointer walks in and clicks it, and the monograms start turning to the accent one every seven frames — top row, middle, bottom, top, bottom, middle, so it reads as a system granting rather than a list iterating. The camera and the middle row's clearance around the pill settle on the same measured exponential; the outer rows deliberately do not, which is what stops the two sides ever looking symmetric.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/roster-grant?ref=cli — pass rows as three arrays of { name, role } and label for the button.

components.name: wordmark-cut
components.title: Wordmark Cut
components.description: A wordmark twice the width of the frame, cooling from a lit gradient to ink while it settles, and then a hard cut onto its last letters and the dot — 1.71× nearer, with a shallow depth of field the wide shot does not have, which is the only thing that says the second shot is closer rather than just bigger. It holds a beat and pushes in, still accelerating on the last frame.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/wordmark-cut?ref=cli — pass word for the wordmark and dotFrom/dotTo for the gradient.

components.name: cursor-track
components.title: Cursor Track
components.description: A synthetic cursor that walks a path of normalized waypoints over any children and pulses a click ring on arrival. A hand-drawn macOS-style arrow with an outline that keeps it readable over arbitrary footage, or a touch puck — for UI sims, and for recordings whose real cursor never made it into the file.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/screens/cursor-track?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

components.name: pulsing-border
components.title: Pulsing Border
components.description: Glowing 'AI is working' frame — a soft pulsing border overlay that breathes around the scene edges while a response streams.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs?ref=cli — pulsing-border draws with WebGL, and Remotion's headless Chromium has no GL context by default — render it with `npx remotion render --gl=angle` (or set `Config.setChromiumOpenGlRenderer("angle")`), or the render fails with 'WebGL is not supported in this browser'.

components.name: follower-rush
components.title: Follower Rush
components.description: An X-style follower notification that piles up — avatars stack in and the count explodes, then the row bends into an undulating wave of faces.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/social/follower-rush?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

components.name: prompt-send
components.title: Prompt Send
components.description: A composer that unrolls from a hairline, writes a brief into itself while the camera cuts in and rides the caret, then cuts back out to the send button as a pointer arrives and clicks it. The typing is eased, not constant — 17 chars/sec on the first word, 33 in the middle, a settle on the last three. Long copy scrolls the field under its own caret and extra suggestions wrap, so the panel fits whatever you put in it.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/ai-input/prompt-send?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

components.name: prompt-zoom
components.title: Prompt Zoom
components.description: An assistant landing screen that offers its suggestions, then cuts — hard, in a single frame — into the caret, where the prompt types itself. The push-in is a measured 2.547× anchored on the text insertion point, not an animated zoom.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/ai-input/prompt-zoom?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

components.name: punch-lines
components.title: Punch Lines
components.description: A run of full-frame title cards that cut hard between beats. A statement card is flicked in from the left line by line and settles on a critically damped curve, then rushes past the camera; a hero card punches its words up from a third of their size in a wave and pushes slowly forward until it cuts. Every curve is fitted from frame measurements — the slide to 0.42px rms over 37 frames.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/punch-lines?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

components.name: orbit-gallery
components.title: Orbit Gallery
components.description: An image-universe hero: a continuous stream of photos flows along an Archimedean spiral (a vortex) from the frame edges into the center — evenly spaced by arc length, shrinking and rotating to follow the coil, with the title held in the clear middle. A slow, cinematic opener for launch and editorial videos.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/orbit-gallery?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

components.name: hero-launch
components.title: Product Hero
components.description: Cinematic product-launch hero — two cards slide into formation as the headline reveals above.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/hero-launch?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

components.name: moodboard-reveal
components.title: Moodboard Reveal
components.description: A kinetic headline with a swapping inline image, then a scattered gallery of photos flies in, the camera pushes through it as the background lifts from near-black to off-white, and it lands on a single hero image.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/moodboard-reveal?ref=cli — this scene spans light and dark by design, so it takes no `mode` — pass `theme` to repaint it.

components.name: search-typing
components.title: Search Typing
components.description: A search field wider than the shot: two thirds in frame, then it comes forward, types across its left half, pages to its right half, and goes back. Every proportion is measured, and the scale pivots on the text baseline so the type never climbs the pixel grid.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/ai-input/search-typing?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

components.name: status-cycle
components.title: Status Cycle
components.description: A centred line whose status pill cycles: the label rolls up behind a hard clip while the pill's width springs past its target and back, and the line re-centres around it. The field then crossfades and a column of chips steps up from below. Copy, palette and every timing are props; the curves are fitted from frame measurements, not eyeballed.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/status-cycle?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

components.name: type-morph
components.title: Type Morph
components.description: A headline that types itself under a glowing caret, sheds its lead, morphs letter by letter, and ends under a colour flood.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/type-morph?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

components.name: snap-cn-ui
components.title: snapcn UI Core
components.description: Shared timeline-fold hook, theme context, and color math for snapcn UI primitives.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs?ref=cli — snapcn components paint from a shadcn token set in lib/snap-cn-ui/theme.ts. Its defaults are shadcn's, so they will already sit correctly next to your Button and Input. To point them at your own palette instead, wrap your compositions in <SnapCnUIProvider theme={{ primary: '#...', ... }} mode="dark">, or pass the same `theme`/`mode` props to a single component. Use concrete hex/oklch values, not var(--primary) — a Remotion render has none of your app's CSS.

components.name: caret
components.title: UI Caret
components.description: A blinking text caret — a controlled vertical bar, or a pure motion atom that blinks deterministically from useCurrentFrame.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs?ref=cli — it paints with `color`, which defaults to `currentColor`, and takes no `mode`.

components.name: input
components.title: UI Input
components.description: A text input whose idle/hover/active/typing/invalid state is a pure function of the timeline; the focus ring, border, caret, and value reveal are keyframed presets.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs?ref=cli — pass `theme` (or wrap the composition in `SnapCnUIProvider`) to repaint it; it takes no `mode`.

components.name: manifesto
components.title: Manifesto
components.description: Three statements, three different arrivals, hard cuts between them. The first is wiped on left to right behind a magenta edge that cools to white, then pushes slowly toward the viewer and slides away mid-motion. The second arrives from the right with its words held apart and the gaps close as it lands — nothing scales, only the spacing moves. The third starts larger than the frame and falls back to a line, losing a fixed share of the remaining distance every frame. Give it three strings; every timing is a prop.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/manifesto?ref=cli — renders transparent on a dark backdrop; pass color if you are compositing onto light.

components.name: read-through
components.title: Read Through
components.description: A sentence set enormous and read a word at a time. Three lines pan left together in eased steps — each step carries the next word to a fixed reading position, decelerating hard into it, dwelling, then accelerating away, the way an eye moves along a line rather than a marquee crawling past. Colour does the reading: a word arrives in the accent and resolves to the text colour as the pan carries it through, so any frame says what has been read and what has not. The lines above and below travel with it in grey, clipped by the frame.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/read-through?ref=cli — paints its own light background; set background and color together if you invert it.

components.name: word-settle
components.title: Word Settle
components.description: A sentence that arrives a word at a time, hot, and cools as it lands. Two clocks running at different speeds: words appear left to right every couple of frames, and a colour head crosses the line more slowly behind them, turning the accent into the text colour as it passes — so the newest words are always warm and the oldest always settled. The whole sentence is laid out and centred once and unrevealed words are hidden rather than removed, so the line never reflows under the reader.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/word-settle?ref=cli — paints its own light background; set background, color and accent together if you invert it.

components.name: chat-thread
components.title: Chat Thread
components.description: A chat thread sending itself — the moment a demo video actually gets shared. Bubbles arrive one at a time and fade up in place; the stack is bottom-anchored so each arrival displaces everything above it, eased, while the whole thread creeps upward underneath so it never looks frozen between messages. The camera pulls back gently across the clip. Messages are a `;`-separated string, so the customizer can edit them.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/chat-thread?ref=cli — paints its own dark background; set background, bubble and color together to re-skin it.

components.name: lcd-type
components.title: LCD Type
components.description: A type specimen on a screen you can see the pixels of. A title accelerates up and out of frame, then lines type themselves a word at a time — each laid out centred at its finished width and revealed left to right while the whole line slides slowly left, so it grows without ever drifting from the middle. Over all of it sits an RGB subpixel grid and a scanline, applied to the whole frame rather than to the glyphs, which is what makes the type read as displayed rather than drawn.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/lcd-type?ref=cli — paints its own dark background; set gridPitch to 0 for clean type.

components.name: sentence-set
components.title: Sentence Set
components.description: A sentence setting itself, a word at a time. Each word arrives grey and a few pixels right of where it belongs, then darkens to black as it closes the gap — one settle driving both. The cadence decelerates, gaps doubling as the line goes on, so the sentence opens in a rush and lands hard on its last word before the next line starts the rhythm again. Laid out and centred once, so nothing already set moves under the reader.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/sentence-set?ref=cli — lines are explicit, one per `;`, because where a sentence breaks is a typographic decision.

components.name: showcase-drift
components.title: Showcase Drift
components.description: A wall of work sliding to a stop behind a headline. The whole scatter arrives from the right and settles, losing a fixed share of the remaining distance every frame — no overshoot, just something heavy coming to rest. The headline never moves: it sits in a band the cards are laid out to avoid, so the type is readable on every frame. The cards are drawn rather than photographed, so the component ships with no hosted assets to break.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/showcase-drift?ref=cli — the layout is a pure function of `seed`; flip it until you like one.

components.name: agent-chat
components.title: Agent Chat
components.description: An agent conversation, from the empty field to the answer. Five beats on one clock: the prompt types itself into a compose field while the camera pushes in, the field scrolls under a soft left edge as the text outgrows it, the message goes and becomes a bubble, an avatar and a typing indicator arrive, and the reply streams back a word at a time — each word grey for a moment before it sets. Only the typing rate is a real decision; every later beat is derived from it.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/agent-chat?ref=cli — the avatar is drawn, not an image, so there is no asset to host.

components.name: version-drop
components.title: Version Drop
components.description: A name typing itself across two shots, and the number it was all for. Three shots on one clock: the name starts large and left-aligned, jump cuts to a smaller framing that pushes in as the words finish arriving, then cuts again to the version — set at the height of the frame, one glyph at a time, each arriving with a ramp through it that resolves to flat. The cuts are cuts; easing between the sizes turns a deliberate edit into a camera that could not make up its mind.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/version-drop?ref=cli — every size and cut frame is a prop.

components.name: agent-open
components.title: Agent Open
components.description: A line assembles a word at a time, resolves to your product's name, and becomes a prompt somebody types. Each new word's letters arrive at their own heights and fall into the baseline together; the name cuts in hard under a colour ramp that sweeps across it; then a caret types the wrong thing, deletes it, and types the right thing, with the last words landing inside a highlight that sweeps off to the right and hands them back at full size. Four acts in 4.8 seconds. Every beat is a prop.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/agent-open?ref=cli — 144 frames at 30fps. Takes theme/mode like every snapcn scene; pass `ramp` if you have a brand gradient to hit.

components.name: phrase-swarm
components.title: Phrase Swarm
components.description: One phrase comes apart and another gathers out of the pieces. The opening line holds, its letters fly outward, and at the peak the scene cuts — identity, position and size all change on one frame — then the closing phrase gathers back over twice as long, its letters arriving at different depths and a couple of them landing late. Two phrases in, 51 frames out. Any two strings, any two lengths.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/phrase-swarm?ref=cli — 51 frames at 30fps, and it takes theme/mode like every snapcn scene. Pairs with @snapcn/agent-open, which ends on the line this one takes apart.

components.name: word-rush
components.title: Word Rush
components.description: A field of words the camera flies through, one line of it that runs at the lens, and the line that answers on the other side. Words hang at random depths, tinted and mostly out of focus; the camera moves forward so they grow, sweep outward and pass either side while new ones fade up behind. One line holds the focal plane, resolves out of the blur, then accelerates at the camera and is gone in seven frames — and the closing line arrives a word at a time, each coming up out of defocus the same way. Position, size and blur are all the same 1/z projection.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/word-rush?ref=cli — 98 frames at 30fps, theme/mode like every snapcn scene. Follows @snapcn/phrase-swarm in the agent-demo template.

components.name: app-reveal
components.title: App Reveal
components.description: A wordmark that folds into an app, and a camera that flies around it. The mark holds the frame alone, shrinks into the header of a card that builds around it, then the camera dives past the card, rolls, and backs off into a settled front-on framing — while the greeting types, the suggestion chips land one at a time and the input bar arrives. The camera is keyed off the reference's own measurements: its distance from the card's apparent width frame by frame, its roll from a straight-line fit to the card's top edge. Every surface the card paints comes from the design system.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/app-reveal?ref=cli — 106 frames at 30fps, theme/mode like every snapcn scene. Follows @snapcn/word-rush in the agent-demo template, which ends on the line this one answers.

components.name: stretch-word
components.title: Stretch Word
components.description: A word that will not stop, and the line that follows it. "And more" says itself normally, then the letter you name starts repeating — moore, mooore, moooore — until the line is wider than the frame and drags itself off the left edge. Then the closing line arrives a word at a time, sliding back to centre as it goes. The repeat happens inside the word, not appended: "moooore" is somebody leaning on a key, "moreooo" is a typo.
components.doc_url: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/stretch-word?ref=cli — 73 frames at 30fps, theme/mode like every snapcn scene. Closes the agent-demo template after @snapcn/app-reveal.

components.name: mcp-server
components.title: MCP Server
components.description: Add a user-scoped MCP server to your product.
components.doc_url: Disable gateway JWT verification, then deploy the Edge Function. A trusted product backend can call it with the signed-in user's access token. For external clients, install the [OAuth Consent block](https://supabase.com/library/docs/nextjs/oauth-consent), enable OAuth and dynamic registration, and set the Auth Site URL to the consent app. Every call runs through the user's RLS-scoped client. OAuth tokens include `client_id`; product sessions do not, so define policies for both paths. See [MCP authentication](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/oauth-server/mcp-authentication) and [token security](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/oauth-server/token-security).

components.name: oauth-consent-nextjs
components.title: OAuth Consent for Next.js
components.description: OAuth 2.1 consent screen and route for an existing authenticated application.
components.doc_url:
After installation, set the following in `supabase/config.toml`. Recent CLI versions already write an `[auth.oauth_server]` section with `enabled = false` — edit that section rather than adding a second one:

```toml
[auth.oauth_server]
enabled = true
authorization_url_path = "/oauth/consent"
```

You'll need to set the following environment variables in your project: `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` and `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`.

components.name: cn
components.title: cn

components.name: theme
components.title: Theme resolution

components.name: use-theme
components.title: useTheme

components.name: use-media-query
components.title: useMediaQuery
components.description: Media query subscription plus usePrefersReducedMotion. Import breakpoints from @velobitsio/tokens rather than re-typing the pixel value, so the JS and CSS breakpoints cannot drift apart.

components.name: use-row-selection
components.title: useRowSelection
components.description: Row selection for DataTable. The selection is DERIVED , the stored set intersected with the rows on screen , so a bulk action can never point at a row the filter has hidden. Returns a stable object identity, which is what keeps DataTable’s memoised rows from re-rendering per keystroke.

components.name: velobits-provider
components.title: VelobitsProvider
components.description: Mount once at the shell root: ThemeProvider + TooltipProvider + MotionConfig reducedMotion="user".

components.name: alert
components.title: Alert
components.description: Status panel. Defaults to polite role="status"; escalate to "alert" deliberately. Tier-S glass on the neutral variant only , the four soft washes would replace the tint.

components.name: badge
components.title: Badge
components.description: Soft washes pair with the matching text token, never with the solid fill.

components.name: button
components.title: Button
components.description: Controls are radius-md. No variant paints --primary as text; `link` uses --primary-text.

components.name: card
components.title: Card
components.description: Tier-S glass by default; surface="panel" for the opaque original, which writes border-border explicitly so it survives an app that skipped the base layer.

components.name: checkbox
components.title: Checkbox
components.description: Includes the indeterminate state bulk-selection headers need.

components.name: field
components.title: Field
components.description: Label/description/error wiring. Keeps BOTH ids in aria-describedby when a field has an error and a hint.

components.name: glass-surface
components.title: GlassSurface
components.description: All three glass tiers behind one prop: surface (Tier S, no blur by default) · overlay · elevated. Never for page backgrounds, table rows, or nested glass.

components.name: input
components.title: Input
components.description: border-input maps to --field-border, the half WCAG 1.4.11 gates.

components.name: label
components.title: Label
components.description: A real <label>, so htmlFor resolves. Non-control roots need aria-labelledby instead.

components.name: native-select
components.title: NativeSelect
components.description: A cva-styled native <select>. Deliberately NOT Radix Select, which is undriveable under happy-dom.

components.name: scroll-area
components.title: ScrollArea
components.description: A scrollable region with a styled scrollbar. The thumb is --field-border, not --border: it is an interactive control, so 1.4.11 applies to it.

components.name: separator
components.title: Separator
components.description: Decorative, so it uses --border and is exempt from 1.4.11.

components.name: skeleton
components.title: Skeleton
components.description: aria-hidden; pair with ONE sr-only live region rather than announcing each block.

components.name: slider
components.title: Slider
components.description: The name goes on the THUMB , Radix puts role="slider" there, so htmlFor and a root aria-label both dangle.

components.name: switch
components.title: Switch
components.description: Applies immediately. Thumb translation is mirrored explicitly for RTL.

components.name: tooltip
components.title: Tooltip
components.description: TooltipProvider is required , Radix throws without it, and under Module Federation it must be a singleton.

components.name: command-palette
components.title: CommandPalette
components.description: cmdk inside a Radix Dialog. The ⌘K listener is opt-in via `shortcut` , a design system must not bind a global key by merely being imported.

components.name: dialog
components.title: Dialog
components.description: The centred form modal. `focusFirstField` exists because autoFocus is silently swallowed by Radix FocusScope.

components.name: dropdown-menu
components.title: DropdownMenu
components.description: Highlight is data-[highlighted], never :hover , Radix drives keyboard focus through it. Cannot host a text input; use Dialog or Popover.

components.name: popover
components.title: Popover
components.description: The elevated tier, for glass stacked on glass. PopoverTitle wires aria-labelledby , Radix content is role="dialog" with no Title part, so it is otherwise unnamed.

components.name: side-panel
components.title: SidePanel
components.description: The anchored reading sheet. Deliberately NOT Dialog and deliberately does NOT redirect focus , the two focus policies are opposites, so do not merge them behind a `side` variant. The bottom variant needs a definite 75dvh.

components.name: toast
components.title: Toast
components.description: Variants use a logical border stripe, not a soft wash: bg-*-soft is a utility and beats --glass-bg from the components layer, flattening the tier.

components.name: accordion
components.title: Accordion
components.description: The one sanctioned height animation: Radix measures --radix-accordion-content-height, so it does not thrash layout the way an unbounded height:auto transition would.

components.name: app-shell
components.title: AppShell
components.description: The authenticated chrome. `sidebar` is a prop rather than a child because it is rendered TWICE , as a rail at md and up, and inside a drawer below it , so a nav item cannot exist in one and not the other. Ships the skip link, which is the most-skipped WCAG requirement in an admin UI.

components.name: breadcrumb
components.title: Breadcrumb
components.description: A named nav landmark around an ordered list. The leaf is a plain span with aria-current="page" , NOT shadcn’s role="link" aria-disabled, which announces static text as a broken link.

components.name: code-block
components.title: CodeBlock
components.description: Preformatted code, with a copy button that survives an insecure origin (navigator.clipboard is absent over plain http). The `terminal` variant is the theme-invariant --code/--on-code pair, which is what a one-time secret is revealed on.

components.name: data-table
components.title: DataTable
components.description: Sorting, selection and row activation over a column registry , deliberately not TanStack, whose grouping and pivoting nothing here uses. aria-sort goes on the th, not the sort button, and an activatable row needs tabIndex + Enter/Space + a target check or it is mouse-only.

components.name: diff-viewer
components.title: DiffViewer
components.description: A unified line diff. The +/− gutter is the primary channel and the green/red wash the secondary , colour alone fails 1.4.1, and the gutter is also the only channel that survives greyscale. Ships `diffLines`, with a guard: LCS is O(n·m) in MEMORY.

components.name: empty-state
components.title: EmptyState
components.description:
First-run, filtered-to-nothing and failed-to-load are three different states; this covers the first two and an Alert covers the third. The title is a

unless headingLevel is set, because an empty state usually sits inside a container that already has the heading.

components.name: form
components.title: Form
components.description: react-hook-form bound to Field’s ARIA wiring. label and description are PROPS, not children, because aria-describedby is assembled before children render , a description left out while its id is still listed is a dangling reference. NOT exported from the npm barrel: react-hook-form is an optional peer.

components.name: motion
components.title: Motion
components.description: Page transitions and capped list staggers on framer-motion, which was already a required peer for VelobitsProvider’s MotionConfig and until now bought nothing else. Subpath-only in the npm package (@velobitsio/ui/motion), like form, because the barrel’s own-code budget has ~4 kB left and nobody should pay for Framer to import a Button. Reduced motion is handled by MotionConfig and the token layer , do NOT add a third path. Stagger caps at STAGGER_LIMIT items so a 200-row list does not take eight seconds to arrive.

components.name: pagination
components.title: Pagination
components.description: Numbers are links, previous/next are buttons: an <a> cannot express "unavailable" without ceasing to be focusable. Unavailability is aria-disabled plus a guard, so focus is not lost at the ends of the range. `paginationRange` returns a CONSTANT number of slots so the control never reflows as you page.

components.title: Magnify Trail
components.description: Images that traverse the screen, magnifying and rising to the top of the stack as they pass the center.

components.name: stacking-grid
components.title: Stacking Grid
components.description: A configurable grid of cards that stacks to the center while scrolling.

components.name: scattered-grid
components.title: Scattered Grid
components.description: A grid that scatters away from the hovered item.

components.name: hover-burst
components.title: Hover Burst
components.description: Images or items that burst around the cursor when it enters an element.

components.name: tag-cloud
components.title: Tag Cloud
components.description: Flat images scattered over a draggable sphere, where depth is only a change of scale.

components.name: falling-text
components.title: Falling Text
components.description: Text that falls and bounces when the cursor moves over it.

components.name: image-bloom
components.title: Image Bloom
components.description: Images that pop up along the cursor's path and fade out behind it.

components.name: dither-cursor
components.title: Dither Cursor
components.description: A trail of dithered dots that follows the cursor and bends the scene behind it.

components.name: page-transition
components.title: Page Transition
components.description: A route transition engine that covers the page during navigation.

components.name: clip-transition
components.title: Clip Transition
components.description: A page transition that clips and scales the page behind a cover.

components.name: band-transition
components.title: Band Transition
components.description: A page transition that sweeps staggered bands across the page.

components.name: stripe-transition
components.title: Stripe Transition
components.description: A page transition that wipes a staggered grid of stripes across the page.

components.name: pixel-transition
components.title: Pixel Transition
components.description: A page transition that pixelates the screen with a fixed grid of squares.

components.name: dropzone
components.title: MediaDrop Dropzone
components.description: Drag-and-drop file upload block built on react-mediadrop's useMediaDrop hook, with per-file progress and cancel.

components.name: avatar-uploader
components.title: MediaDrop Avatar Uploader
components.description: Circular single-image avatar picker built on react-mediadrop's useMediaDrop hook, with click/drag replace and upload progress.

components.name: multi-file-upload-form
components.title: MediaDrop Multi-File Upload Form
components.description: Multi-file picker with a review list and an explicit submit step — add files, then upload — with per-file progress, cancel, and retry.

components.name: s3-direct-upload
components.title: MediaDrop S3 Direct Upload
components.description: Direct-to-S3 upload block using a presigned PUT URL you supply per file, built on react-mediadrop's xhr-upload transport.

components.name: tokens
components.title: ai2 Tokens
components.description: ai2 extension tokens: tone colors (brand, success, warning, danger, info + soft pairs), surface-2/3 and motion variables. Required by every ai2 component; installed automatically as a dependency.

components.name: button
components.title: Button
components.description: Button with a full variant x tone x size matrix: 5 variants (solid, soft, outline, ghost, link), 6 tones (neutral, brand, success, warning, danger, info), 10 sizes (xs-xl plus square icon-xs through icon-xl for icon-only buttons), plus isLoading and asChild. Every tone is driven by ai2 semantic tokens.
components.doc_url: Use tone for semantic intent (brand for primary product actions, danger for destructive) and variant for visual weight. isLoading disables the button and shows a spinner.

components.name: theme-indigo
components.title: ai2 Indigo
components.description: Indigo brand theme for ai2: recolors the brand tone channel (solid + soft pairs) in light and dark mode. Install on top of any ai2 setup; every component using tone=brand follows automatically.

components.name: glass
components.title: Glass
components.description: Floating surface treatments: glass.overlay (translucent + blur, for tooltips/dropdowns), glass.frosted (heavier blur + deep layered shadow, for modals), glass.solid (opaque), plus shadow.default and shadow.max elevation tokens. Class-string helpers composed with cn(); backgrounds wired to ai2 tokens so glass follows any theme in both modes. Inspired by the Delphi glass system.
components.doc_url: Use glass.* only when floating UI sits over VARIED content. Never stack glass on glass (use shadow.default + glass.solid for lower layers). Use shadow.max on exactly one surface per page (the primary prompt input or sticky bar).

components.name: primitives
components.title: Primitives
components.description: Headless primitive adapter: the single entry point every ai2 component imports its unstyled behaviour from. Components never import the primitive library directly, so the provider is swapped in one file instead of thirty. Re-exports the twenty-four Radix UI namespaces the system uses (Dialog, Popover, Select, Tabs, Tooltip, Menu, and the rest). Components with no cross-library equivalent, such as Command, Toast, Drawer, Calendar, OTP input, Carousel and Resizable, keep their own dependency on purpose.
components.doc_url: Swap the provider here, not in components. Anything without a cross-library equivalent stays out of this file so the surface does not promise a swap it cannot deliver.

components.name: primitives-base
components.title: Primitives (Base UI)
components.description: The second provider behind the ai2 primitive adapter: the same surface as @ai2/primitives, bound to Base UI instead of Radix. A pro block imports the adapter, not the library, so the same block source runs on either one. Anatomy differences are absorbed here (Base UI wraps the slider track in a Control part and calls the filled part Indicator, and it renders a native range input inside the thumb, so focus styling is mirrored from focus-visible to focus-within). Primitives with no Base UI counterpart are deliberately left out rather than silently falling back to Radix.
components.doc_url: Install this instead of @ai2/primitives when you want the block to run on Base UI. Nothing else in the block changes.

components.name: card
components.title: Card
components.description: Card surface with 4 variants (outline, elevated, soft, glass) and 3 inset scales (sm, md, lg) that pad header, content and footer together. Parts: Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardAction, CardContent, CardFooter.
components.doc_url: Use variant for surface depth (elevated for emphasis, soft for nested surfaces, glass over imagery) and inset to scale internal padding consistently across all parts. The glass variant derives from the @ai2/glass surface treatments.

components.name: file-input
components.title: File Input
components.description: Styled file picker: hidden native input under a custom surface with a leading icon (lucide or remixicon), placeholder or selected file name, multiple-file count and an optional clear button. Follows the Input contract: 3 variants (outline, soft, ghost), 3 sizes (sm, md, lg), 3 tones (neutral, success, danger). States: empty, selected, disabled, invalid via aria-invalid.
components.doc_url: Use in place of a bare input[type=file]. The icon prop swaps the paperclip; clearable={false} hides the clear button. Reads files from the native change event, so existing form handling keeps working.

components.name: input-group
components.title: Input Group
components.description: Composable input shell: InputGroup carries the field appearance with 3 variants (outline, soft, ghost), 3 sizes (sm, md, lg) and 3 tones (neutral, success, danger); InputGroupInput/InputGroupTextarea render transparent controls inside; InputGroupAddon places icons, text or buttons at inline-start, inline-end, block-start or block-end; InputGroupText and InputGroupButton for addon content.
components.doc_url: Use for icons or actions inside a text field: leading search icon, trailing clear button, kbd hints, prefixes like https://. Focus and invalid state lift from the inner control to the group border. Use FileInput for file uploads instead.

components.name: input
components.title: Input
components.description: Text input with 3 variants (outline, soft, ghost), 3 sizes (sm, md, lg) and 3 tones (neutral, success, danger) for validation states via border and focus ring color. Invalid state also via aria-invalid.
components.doc_url: Set aria-invalid on validation errors; the destructive ring style is built in. Use variant=soft on dense forms and filled surfaces.

components.name: textarea
components.title: Textarea
components.description: Auto-growing textarea (field-sizing-content) with 3 variants (outline, soft, ghost), 3 sizes (sm, md, lg) and 3 tones (neutral, success, danger) matching Input. Invalid state also via aria-invalid.
components.doc_url: Shares variant language with Input so forms stay consistent. It grows with content by default via field-sizing.

components.name: label
components.title: Label
components.description: Accessible form label built on radix-ui Label with 2 sizes (sm, md). Auto-dims when the associated control is disabled.
components.doc_url: Pair with any form control via htmlFor. Handles peer-disabled and group-data-disabled dimming automatically.

components.name: checkbox
components.title: Checkbox
components.description: Checkbox on radix-ui with 4 tones (neutral, brand, success, danger) and 3 sizes (sm, md, lg). Invalid state via aria-invalid.
components.doc_url: tone sets the checked fill color. Use inside a Label for a clickable row.

components.name: radio-group
components.title: Radio Group
components.description: Radio group + item on radix-ui with 4 tones and 3 sizes. Exports RadioGroup and RadioGroupItem.
components.doc_url: Wrap RadioGroupItem elements in RadioGroup and give each item a value. tone/size are set per item.

components.name: switch
components.title: Switch
components.description: Toggle switch on radix-ui with 4 tones (neutral, brand, success, danger) and 3 sizes (sm, md, lg). Thumb travel and easing use ai2 motion tokens.
components.doc_url: tone sets the checked track color. Use for instant-apply settings; use Checkbox for form submission.

components.name: badge
components.title: Badge
components.description: Badge with a variant x tone x size matrix: 3 variants (solid, soft, outline), 6 tones, 3 sizes (sm, md, lg). Icons work with both lucide svg and remixicon i children. Supports asChild for links.
components.doc_url: Use soft variant for status pills, solid for counts, outline for subtle tags. tone carries the semantic meaning.

components.name: avatar
components.title: Avatar
components.description: Avatar on radix-ui with 5 sizes (xs-xl) and 2 shapes (circle, rounded), plus AvatarGroup for overlapping stacks with an optional max that collapses the rest into a +N tile. Exports Avatar, AvatarImage, AvatarFallback, AvatarGroup.
components.doc_url: AvatarFallback renders while the image loads or if it fails. Fallback text is sized automatically per avatar size.

components.name: progress
components.title: Progress
components.description: Progress bar on radix-ui with 6 tones (neutral, brand, success, warning, danger, info) and 3 sizes. Fill animates using ai2 motion tokens.
components.doc_url: Pass value 0-100. tone conveys status (success for complete, danger for over-quota).

components.name: skeleton
components.title: Skeleton
components.description: Loading placeholder on the ai2 surface-3 token with 3 shapes (line, circle, rect) and 2 animations (pulse, none). Style dimensions via className.
components.doc_url: Compose multiple Skeletons to mirror the shape of the content that is loading.

components.name: spinner
components.title: Spinner
components.description: Loading spinner (lucide) with 3 tones (current, brand, muted) and 4 sizes (sm-xl). Has role=status and an aria-label.
components.doc_url: tone=current inherits text color, so it matches whatever context it sits in (e.g. inside a Button).

components.name: separator
components.title: Separator
components.description: Horizontal or vertical divider on radix-ui with 2 variants (solid, dashed) and an optional centered label that renders a two-line divider with text (e.g. OR). Decorative by default with correct aria semantics when not.
components.doc_url: Set orientation=vertical inside a flex row; give the row a height for the divider to show.

components.name: kbd
components.title: Kbd
components.description: Keyboard key hint styled with the ai2 mono font and surface tokens. Use for shortcuts and command hints.
components.doc_url: Combine multiple Kbd elements for chords, e.g. Ctrl + K.

components.name: field
components.title: Field
components.description: Form field composition: Field, FieldControl, FieldLabel, FieldDescription, FieldError. Auto-wires accessibility: FieldControl (a Slot around any control) receives a generated id, aria-describedby pointing at the description and error, and aria-invalid; the label targets the control automatically. invalid/disabled props drive data attributes, label color and dimming. orientation switches vertical (default) and horizontal (label-left, e.g. switch rows).
components.doc_url: Wrap the control in FieldControl to get id/aria-describedby/aria-invalid wiring for free. FieldError renders nothing when empty, so you can bind it directly to a form library's error string; a present error marks the whole field invalid.

components.name: tabs
components.title: Tabs
components.description: Tabs on radix-ui with 3 variants (solid segmented, line underline, pill) and 2 sizes (sm, md). Variant and size flow from TabsList to every trigger via context. Exports Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent.
components.doc_url: Set variant on TabsList; triggers inherit it via context. Use line for docs-style pages, pill for compact filters.

components.name: accordion
components.title: Accordion
components.description: Accordion on radix-ui with 3 variants (default divided rows, separated cards, outline boxed) plus animated open/close (ai2 motion tokens) and a rotating chevron. Variant flows from Accordion to every item via context. Exports Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent.
components.doc_url: Pass type=single collapsible for FAQ, type=multiple for settings panels. Height animation uses the radix content-height variable.

components.name: alert
components.title: Alert
components.description: Alert with a variant x tone matrix: 2 variants (soft, outline) x 6 tones. Optional leading icon, AlertTitle and AlertDescription. role=alert.
components.doc_url: Place an icon as the first child; the grid layout indents the title/description automatically. tone carries the semantic meaning.

components.name: tooltip
components.title: Tooltip
components.description: Tooltip on radix-ui with portal, arrow, directional slide/zoom animations and 2 content sizes (sm, md). Tooltip wraps its own Provider, so a single import works out of the box.
components.doc_url: Wrap the trigger with TooltipTrigger asChild to attach to any element. Content renders in a portal so it escapes overflow-hidden parents.

components.name: breadcrumb
components.title: Breadcrumb
components.description: Accessible breadcrumb (nav + ordered list) with link, current page, separator and ellipsis parts. Semantic aria-current on the active page.
components.doc_url: Use BreadcrumbPage for the current page (not a link) and BreadcrumbEllipsis to collapse long trails.

components.name: dialog
components.title: Dialog
components.description: Modal dialog on radix-ui with portal, overlay, focus trap, fade/zoom animations and 5 content sizes (sm, md, lg, xl, full) that cap the width from the sm breakpoint up while staying full width minus a margin on mobile. Exports Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogFooter, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogClose.
components.doc_url: showClose defaults to true. Always include DialogTitle (visually hidden with sr-only if needed) for accessibility.

components.name: sheet
components.title: Sheet
components.description: Slide-in panel on radix-ui Dialog with 4 sides (right, left, top, bottom), 3 sizes (sm, md, lg) that set the panel width for the left/right sides, and directional slide animations using ai2 motion tokens.
components.doc_url: Set side on SheetContent. Use for navigation drawers (left/right) and mobile filters (bottom).

components.name: popover
components.title: Popover
components.description: Popover on radix-ui with portal, directional slide/zoom animations, 3 content sizes (sm, md, lg) and an optional anchor. Exports Popover, PopoverTrigger, PopoverContent, PopoverAnchor.
components.doc_url: Content renders in a portal so it escapes overflow-hidden. Use PopoverAnchor to detach the position from the trigger.

components.name: dropdown-menu
components.title: Dropdown Menu
components.description: Full dropdown menu on radix-ui: items (default + danger variant), checkbox items, radio group, submenus, labels, separators and shortcuts. Keyboard navigable.
components.doc_url: Use variant=danger on destructive items. Submenus, checkbox and radio items handle their own indicators.

components.name: select
components.title: Select
components.description: Select on radix-ui. Trigger follows the Input contract: 3 variants (outline, soft, ghost), 3 sizes (sm, md, lg), 3 tones (neutral, success, danger). Grouped items, labels, separators, scroll buttons, checkmark indicator; popper positioned with matching width.
components.doc_url: Pair SelectTrigger + SelectValue with SelectContent > SelectItem. size is set on SelectTrigger.

components.name: command
components.title: Command
components.description: Command palette (cmdk) with fuzzy search, groups, items, shortcuts and a CommandDialog wrapper for a ⌘K experience.
components.doc_url: Use CommandDialog for a global ⌘K palette; bind it to a keydown listener. Plain Command works inline (e.g. inside a Popover combobox).

components.name: sonner
components.title: Toast (Sonner)
components.description: Toast notifications via sonner, themed with ai2 tokens and synced to next-themes. Drop the Toaster once in your root layout, then call toast() anywhere.
components.doc_url: Render <Toaster /> once near the root. Import { toast } from 'sonner' to trigger notifications from anywhere.

components.name: table
components.title: Table
components.description: Composable table primitives (Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell, TableCaption) with hover rows, selected state and horizontal scroll. Table takes density (compact, comfortable, relaxed) and variant (line, striped, outline), both flowing to rows and cells via context.
components.doc_url: Wrap in your own data logic (e.g. TanStack Table) or use directly. The container handles overflow-x for wide tables.

components.name: alert-dialog
components.title: Alert Dialog
components.description: Confirmation dialog on radix-ui AlertDialog for destructive or irreversible actions. Action button defaults to the danger tone; cancel is focused first per WAI-ARIA.
components.doc_url: Use for destructive confirmations (delete, revoke). Unlike Dialog it has no close X and cannot be dismissed by clicking outside.

components.name: toggle
components.title: Toggle
components.description: Two-state toggle button on radix-ui with 2 variants (default, outline), 3 sizes and 2 tones (neutral, brand). Pressed state uses the accent token (neutral) or brand-soft (brand).
components.doc_url: Use for on/off formatting controls (bold, italic). For groups use toggle-group.

components.name: toggle-group
components.title: Toggle Group
components.description: Single or multiple selection toggle group on radix-ui. Inherits variant/size/tone from the group via context; outline variant renders as a segmented control.
components.doc_url: Set type=single or type=multiple on ToggleGroup. variant=outline joins items into a segmented control.

components.name: pagination
components.title: Pagination
components.description: Accessible pagination nav (previous/next, page links, ellipsis) styled with ai2 button variants. Current page gets aria-current.
components.doc_url: Render your page numbers into PaginationLink and set isActive on the current one. Works with any router link via asChild patterns.

components.name: combobox
components.title: Combobox
components.description: Searchable single-select built from Popover + Command. Trigger follows the Input contract: 3 variants (outline, soft, ghost), 3 sizes (sm, md, lg), 3 tones (neutral, success, danger). Controlled or uncontrolled via value/defaultValue and onValueChange; options as {value, label} pairs.
components.doc_url: Pass options as an array of {value, label, disabled?}. Selecting the active option again clears the value.

components.name: slider
components.title: Slider
components.description: Range slider on radix-ui with 4 tones (neutral, brand, success, danger) coloring the range and thumb, and 3 sizes (sm, md, lg) for the track and thumb. Supports single and multi-thumb, horizontal and vertical.
components.doc_url: Pass value/defaultValue as an array; the number of thumbs follows its length. tone conveys intent (brand for primary controls, danger for destructive ranges).

components.name: scroll-area
components.title: Scroll Area
components.description: Custom cross-browser scroll container on radix-ui with a thin token-colored scrollbar. Exports ScrollArea and ScrollBar (vertical or horizontal orientation).
components.doc_url: Give the ScrollArea a fixed height (or max-height) so its content can overflow. Add a horizontal ScrollBar inside for two-axis scrolling.

components.name: hover-card
components.title: Hover Card
components.description: Rich hover preview on radix-ui with portal, directional slide/zoom animations and 3 content sizes (sm, md, lg). Exports HoverCard, HoverCardTrigger, HoverCardContent.
components.doc_url: Use for non-essential preview content shown on hover (user cards, link previews). For click-triggered content use Popover, for tap-friendly hints use Tooltip.

components.name: collapsible
components.title: Collapsible
components.description: Single expand/collapse region on radix-ui. Exports Collapsible, CollapsibleTrigger, CollapsibleContent. Unstyled by design so it composes into any layout.
components.doc_url: Use for a single show/hide toggle (a filter panel, a see-more block). For a set of mutually exclusive panels use Accordion.

components.name: button-group
components.title: Button Group
components.description: Joins buttons, inputs and selects into a single segmented control on horizontal or vertical orientation, collapsing inner radii and borders. Exports ButtonGroup, ButtonGroupText, ButtonGroupSeparator.
components.doc_url: Wrap ai2 Buttons (and optionally Input, Select, ButtonGroupText) to fuse them into one control. ButtonGroupSeparator draws a divider between segments.

components.name: empty
components.title: Empty
components.description: Empty-state placeholder: Empty wrapper with EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia (default or icon variant), EmptyTitle, EmptyDescription and EmptyContent for actions. Centered, balanced text, dashed-border ready.
components.doc_url: Use for no-data, no-results and first-run states. EmptyMedia variant=icon frames a lucide or remixicon glyph; put a Button or link inside EmptyContent.

components.name: item
components.title: Item
components.description: List/row primitive with 3 variants (default, outline, muted) and 2 sizes (default, sm). Parts: Item, ItemGroup, ItemMedia (default/icon/image), ItemContent, ItemTitle, ItemDescription, ItemActions, ItemHeader, ItemFooter, ItemSeparator. asChild renders the row as a link.
components.doc_url: Compose settings rows, file lists and notification items. ItemMedia icon/image variants frame leading content; ItemActions holds trailing buttons. Group with ItemGroup + ItemSeparator.

components.name: drawer
components.title: Drawer
components.description: Draggable drawer on vaul with 4 directions (top, right, bottom, left), a drag handle on the bottom variant, overlay and snap behavior. Exports Drawer, DrawerTrigger, DrawerContent, DrawerHeader, DrawerFooter, DrawerTitle, DrawerDescription, DrawerClose, DrawerOverlay, DrawerPortal.
components.doc_url: Use for mobile bottom sheets and touch-friendly panels with drag-to-dismiss. For a plain slide-in panel without dragging use Sheet; for a centered modal use Dialog.

components.name: input-otp
components.title: Input OTP
components.description: One-time-passcode input on input-otp with individual slots, a blinking fake caret, active-slot ring and aria-invalid danger styling. Exports InputOTP, InputOTPGroup, InputOTPSlot, InputOTPSeparator.
components.doc_url: Set maxLength to the code length and group slots with InputOTPGroup; InputOTPSeparator draws a divider between groups. Read the value from onChange.

components.name: calendar
components.title: Calendar
components.description: Date calendar on react-day-picker v10 styled with ai2 Button and tokens. Single, multiple and range selection, dropdown or label caption, outside days, week numbers. Exports Calendar, CalendarDayButton.
components.doc_url: Pass mode single/multiple/range with selected + onSelect. captionLayout=dropdown adds month/year dropdowns. For a popover-triggered field use DatePicker.

components.name: date-picker
components.title: Date Picker
components.description: Date field that opens a Calendar in a Popover. Controlled or uncontrolled via value/defaultValue and onValueChange; formats the selected date with date-fns and shows a placeholder when empty.
components.doc_url: Single-date picker composed from Calendar + Popover + Button. Read the value from onValueChange; pass defaultValue for uncontrolled use.

components.name: context-menu
components.title: Context Menu
components.description: Right-click menu on radix-ui with items, checkbox and radio items, submenus, labels, separators and shortcuts. Item variant default or danger. Icons work with lucide svg and remixicon i. Exports the full ContextMenu part set.
components.doc_url: Wrap the target in ContextMenuTrigger; the menu opens on right-click. Use variant=danger on destructive items. Mirrors DropdownMenu but for contextual actions.

components.name: menubar
components.title: Menubar
components.description: Application menu bar on radix-ui with top-level menus, items, checkbox and radio items, submenus, labels, separators and shortcuts. Item variant default or danger. Icons work with lucide svg and remixicon i. Exports the full Menubar part set.
components.doc_url: Use for desktop-style File/Edit/View menus across the top of an app. Each MenubarMenu holds a MenubarTrigger + MenubarContent. Use variant=danger on destructive items.

components.name: resizable
components.title: Resizable
components.description: Resizable split panels on react-resizable-panels with horizontal or vertical groups and an optional drag handle. Exports ResizablePanelGroup, ResizablePanel, ResizableHandle.
components.doc_url: Set direction on ResizablePanelGroup (horizontal/vertical), size each ResizablePanel with defaultSize, and separate them with ResizableHandle (withHandle shows a grip).

components.name: carousel
components.title: Carousel
components.description: Slider/carousel on embla-carousel-react with horizontal or vertical orientation, keyboard support and prev/next controls built from ai2 Button. Exports Carousel, CarouselContent, CarouselItem, CarouselPrevious, CarouselNext.
components.doc_url: Wrap slides in CarouselItem inside CarouselContent; set basis on items for multi-slide views. Pass opts for embla options and plugins for autoplay. setApi exposes the embla api.

components.doc_url: These files use explicit `.ts` extensions in their relative imports. If your TypeScript config reports "An import path can only end with a '.ts' extension when 'allowImportingTsExtensions' is enabled," add `"allowImportingTsExtensions": true` to your tsconfig.json's compilerOptions.
